text:
Maya: FYI — one of our pilot customers asked for quick, prescriptive advisor output for batching/caching/quant to cut cost ~40% while keeping p99 under 120ms for short chats. they want something ship-ready in 2 sprints.
Sam: can you paste the exact asks?
Maya: they want per-route recommendations + a tiny SDK that returns a config blob, safety labels for regulated routes, and an expected cost/latency estimate.
Ashley: split work: Sprint 1 = advisor API + SDK + docs + telemetry; Sprint 2 = eval-triggered alerts + UI + policy tags.
Dmitri: agree. core rules engine + API is small; eval alerts need eval infra and datasets.
Leo: minimal Sprint 1 deliverables?
Maya: API returning advice, SDK (py/node), advice keys: batching (time_window, max_batch), cache hints (prefix_ttl), quant rec + fallback, safety_label, estimated_delta.
Sam: acceptance criteria: API <50ms response, example app, telemetry events emitted, 2 pilots onboarded and reporting before/after metrics within 2 weeks.
Ashley: include safety_label values: safe / opt-in / disallowed.
Dmitri: quant should include a regression_gate: e.g., require_local_eval or A/B threshold.
Maya: Sprint 1 returns recommended_profile + guidance text; Sprint 2 adds eval harness + automated alerts.
Sam: launch criteria draft: API+SDK published, docs+example app, telemetry validated, 2 pilots with before/after p50/p99 & cost reports, rollback plan for quant regressions.
product-bot: Reminder: gate pilot behind feature flag and require opt-in telemetry.
Maya: next steps: Ash/Dmitri write short PRD section + acceptance tests; Leo draft pilot outreach; Sam create tracking sheet. aiming to demo advisor & example app to pilot customer in 3 weeks. :rocket:
